intro.text: A glowing paste made from worms that lets a boat whose hull is coated with it float on the dark not-water.
A glowing paste made from processed worms; anything coated with it can interact with the Cognitive Realm's unsea, and it can Invest living beings who wear or eat it.

description.text: A coat stays effective for roughly five days.
Whether coated on a living being or eaten, it Invests them.
Navigators usually eat it to hold the Investiture their ability needs.
